title: Grateful Dead Live at Lanai Theater on 1969-11-15
source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Cassette > PCM > CDR > iMac > SHN; Transfer Info: SHN's > TLH > flac16 > Samplitude (16/44 .wav)> Adobe Audition 3.0 (16/44 .wav)> TLH flac16

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of a rare East Bay theater gig, notable for a power loss during Love Light that creates an amusing acapella interlude rescued by Pigpen’s harmonica.
ai_review.review: The tape captures a seldom‑played concert in an old movie house near Richmond, with generally clear soundboard quality. The performance is memorable mainly for the mid‑song power outage on “Love Light,” which forces the band into a brief a‑capella section before Garcia’s electrified guitar returns, and Pigpen’s harmonica lifts the whole set.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one detailed review; it praises the rarity and Pigpen's contribution but notes a disruptive power loss that hurts the flow, while recording quality appears adequate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear soundboard mix; main technical issue is the on‑stage power outage that creates an acoustic break, but no complaints about audio fidelity or noise.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Typical early set interrupted by a sudden loss of electricity during “Love Light,” leading to a brief a‑capella segment before the band resumes with full electric sound.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s guitar only comes back fully when power is restored, highlighting his reliance on amplification for this song.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s early spoken intro “whiffs,” providing a less‑polished moment before the main set.
